'''AR-2B Utility Droids''', were [[Class five droid/Legends|fifth-degree]] menial [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] manufactured by [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] and were used in great number in most of the corporations on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] during the rebellion era.

==Characteristics==
Set at a cost of 2,250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the AR-2Bs had a humanoid body shape and were designed specifically for menial labor, in the home, the office or the industrial site. They could understand instruction given in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], but had the tendency to be exceptionally literal-minded. Their rudimentary [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] allowed them to speak Basic, but their voice was harsh and buzzing and obviously synthetic. Those [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had a vocabulary of only 300 words. AR-2Bs were equipped with a [[C3-DD NeuroNet brain]] which was incapable of abstract thought of understanding hypothetical reasoning.
